notes.note: Finn returned to the side and scored well with his 85 from his 13 disposals. He is a bench option for you at best.
9 marks 6 tackles to go with 26 touches for Finn and his second 100+ for the season. A great outing for him but don't expect it all the time.
Finn's second best score this year and best since he returned to the team. 22 disposals and a couple of goals as he had the job of tagging Heeney for much of the game.
